items.description: Floor cleaning, connection check, skirting board replacement (utility room and hallway)
items.rationale: Escape of water from a hose is insured. Cleaning of affected surfaces (7.1.7(h)), source check (7.1.7(e)) and skirting replacement (fixed trim, a building component) are all covered. Price is a fair ordinary amount for a combined flat rate.

items.description: Moisture measurement and drying of utility room and hallway floor incl. drying unit
items.rationale: Moisture measurement, drying and equipment hire are covered under 7.1.7(b) and (e). The drying unit is charged at a flat rate, so electricity is included. Both rooms were affected.

items.description: Assessment and drying of small framed print
items.rationale: The print is movable household contents, not insured property under 4.3(d). The schedule shows only the building, so the item was not individually notified and the 5.2.6 EUR 1,000 limit does not help. A mass-produced poster in a pine frame is not an item of particular value, so 5.2.6 does not apply and t is 0.
